race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
race.verdict: OUR PLANET justified market confidence when making a winning debut for this yard here on Friday and he's still very well treated under a penalty. It shouldn't be long before Stash The Cash takes advantage of a reduced mark for his up-and-coming handler so rates the main threat ahead of Fancy Dancer , who finished slightly ahead of him here 3 weeks ago. OUR PLANET (IRE) STASH THE CASH (IRE) FANCY DANCER
